Test fruit salad

This chilled fruit salad comes together in minutes and travels well to potlucks.


Prep time
10 min

Servings
4

Ingredients

  • 2 apples, diced
  • 3 oranges, sectioned
  • 1 banana, sliced

Directions

  1. Toss the fruit together in a large bowl.
  2. Chill until serving.

Tips

  • Add a squeeze of lime to keep the apple slices from browning.
